class.name: OcgSelectmgrCompositionfilter
class.brief_description: A framework to define a compound filter composed of two or more simple filters.
class.description: ! A framework to define a compound filter composed of ! two or more simple filters.

method.name: Add
method.description: Adds the filter afilter to a filter object created by a filter class inheriting this framework.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Removes the filter aFilter from this framework.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Returns true if this framework is empty.

method.name: IsIn
method.description: Returns true if the filter aFilter is in this framework.

method.name: StoredFilters
method.description: Returns the list of stored filters from this framework.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the filters used in this framework.
